trip-platform.title: Trip — Ride-Sharing Platform API
trip-platform.tagline: Backend for a ride-sharing product: users, drivers, trips and vehicles.
trip-platform.problem: A ride-sharing product has to authenticate drivers and riders reliably, follow vehicles in real time, and notify both sides the moment a trip changes state — without the API collapsing into one tangled layer of controllers.
trip-platform.solution: I designed and implemented a scalable RESTful API in Laravel 10 covering users, drivers, trips and vehicle management, organised into Services, Repositories and API Resources. Authentication combines JWT and Laravel Sanctum with OTP verification over SMS. Supabase (PostgreSQL) handles real-time driver location tracking and geospatial data, Firebase delivers push notifications through kreait/laravel-firebase, and optional Redis caching and queue handling were added for performance.
trip-platform.role: Backend developer, freelance / contract — API design, authentication, real-time data and architecture.
trip-platform.note: Private client project. Source code available upon request.
highlights: Scalable RESTful API supporting users, drivers, trips and vehicle management
Secure authentication with JWT and Laravel Sanctum, plus OTP verification via SMS integration
Supabase (PostgreSQL) for real-time driver location tracking and geospatial data handling
Firebase push notifications implemented with kreait/laravel-firebase
Modular architecture using Services, Repositories and API Resources
Optional Redis-based caching and queue handling for performance optimisation

baraa.title: Baraa — Mobile Applications Backend
baraa.tagline: 150+ REST endpoints behind an e-commerce and an inventory mobile app.
baraa.problem: Two mobile apps — an e-commerce storefront and an inventory tool — needed a single backend: a large, consistent REST surface with real authentication, clear role separation, and a schema that stays fast as catalogues and carts grow.
baraa.solution: I designed and implemented 150+ RESTful API endpoints in Laravel 10 for products, categories, stores, carts, cart items and favourites. Authentication uses JWT with a refresh token flow and email-OTP verification, with role-based access control across the endpoints, and the MySQL schema and queries were optimised for performance and scalability. The codebase is split Controllers to Services to Repositories, sends Firebase FCM push notifications, and publishes an OpenAPI reference generated with L5 Swagger. Backend services were deployed and integrated with Supabase under a secured environment configuration.
baraa.role: Backend developer — API design, authentication, database schema and deployment.
highlights: 150+ RESTful API endpoints for e-commerce and inventory mobile apps
JWT authentication with refresh token flow and role-based access control (RBAC)
Email-OTP account verification and OTP-based password reset
MySQL schema and query optimisation for performance and scalability
Firebase FCM push notifications and an OpenAPI reference via L5 Swagger
Deployed and integrated with Supabase under a secure environment configuration

stock-prediction.title: Stock Price Trend Prediction
stock-prediction.tagline: A three-model deep learning ensemble that calls a stock's direction 30 trading days out.
stock-prediction.problem: Predicting whether a stock closes higher or lower 30 trading days from now means reading three signals at once: sudden volatility, long-range seasonal structure, and sequential memory. No single architecture reads all three well.
stock-prediction.solution: I designed an ensemble of three complementary architectures — a Temporal Convolutional Network, a Transformer encoder and an attention-based BiLSTM — combined by weighted soft voting. The feature pipeline engineers 60+ technical indicators (SMA, EMA, RSI, MACD, ATR, Bollinger Bands, VWAP) and then narrows them through correlation filtering and mutual information. Training applies Focal Loss, label smoothing, learning-rate warm-up, gradient clipping and walk-forward validation to keep the evaluation time-aware and free of leakage.
stock-prediction.results: 58–62% accuracy and 0.60–0.66 AUC-ROC on imbalanced financial time-series data.
stock-prediction.role: Designed the deep learning ensemble and the feature-engineering pipeline.
stock-prediction.note: Neural Networks project at Damascus University, Faculty of IT Engineering (Year 4, AI department). The repository records it as a team project, with the dataset taken from a Kaggle competition.
highlights: Advanced deep learning ensemble for 30-day stock price movement prediction (rise / fall)
Three complementary architectures: TCN, Transformer encoder and attention-based BiLSTM
60+ engineered technical indicators: SMA, EMA, RSI, MACD, ATR, Bollinger Bands, VWAP
Feature selection by correlation filtering and mutual information
Focal Loss, label smoothing, LR warm-up, gradient clipping and walk-forward validation
58–62% accuracy and 0.60–0.66 AUC-ROC on imbalanced financial time-series data

school-system.title: School Management System — Frontend
school-system.tagline: A responsive admin dashboard serving admins, teachers and students from one interface.
school-system.problem: A school platform has to serve admins, teachers and students from the same interface, each seeing a different subset of it — and stay readable in Arabic, on a phone, in either theme.
school-system.solution: I built 20+ reusable, modular React components for a responsive admin dashboard, with state management, protected routes behind JWT authentication, and role-based UI rendering that changes what each role can reach. The layouts are structured around interactive tables for attendance, grades and scheduling across 35 routes, styled with Tailwind CSS and backed by a Zustand store and an Axios service layer with token-refresh interceptors.
school-system.role: Frontend developer — component architecture, routing, role-based UI and state management.
school-system.note: The repository holds a full-stack platform backed by a Laravel API; the contribution recorded in my CV is the React frontend.
highlights: 20+ reusable, modular React components for a responsive admin dashboard
Protected routes with JWT authentication and dynamic role-based UI rendering
Structured layouts with interactive tables for attendance, grades and scheduling
Zustand state management and an Axios service layer with token-refresh interceptors
Full Arabic RTL layout alongside dark and light themes
35 dashboard routes covering students, teachers, exams, assignments and schedules
